chapter_level: Standing L2 script-and-register hazard, whole poem. The song runs on તળપદાં and લય forms — હાલીએ, ભેરુ, ઝાલીએ, નકામ, છો ને, પિછાણીએ, મોઝારે, કો, છઈએ, and the લય-carrying રે in `હોય નહીં રે તેને`, `ખોટું રે ખોટું`, `કોણ રે ડુબાડે`. Every one of them is explained as બોલી or as લય at the point of use and none is ever corrected toward માનક ગુજરાતી inside a quoted line, or called a mistake. An L2 child already half-suspects poem-Gujarati of being broken Gujarati; a single 'correction' anywhere in the chapter teaches that suspicion.

Printed inconsistency inside this one chapter, recorded not repaired. The verse on the first printed page sets `કો` and `છઈએ`; the MCQ block on a later printed page quotes the same line as `કો'` and `છીએ`. Reading scenes quote the verse's forms; Agent 10 answers the exercise from the exercise's own printed wording. Neither spelling may be presented to the child as the wrong one.

Sensitivity, standing across the chapter. The first કડી names both ખુદા and રામ, and the એકતારો and its singer are a devotional image. The song's argument is શ્રમ and આત્મબળ, addressed even-handedly in the poet's own idiom; it is not a claim about either tradition. No topic, summary or recall answer may turn any કડી into a lesson about faith, a comparison of religions, or a statement that praying is useless. agents/08_sensitivity_safety.md owns the full treatment; this is the standing boundary.

Std-7 genre gate has a consequence for the craft rule. At std 7 the સ્વરૂપ is experienced and never labelled: no અલંકાર, છંદ or genre tag anywhere in the plan, and `figures_of_speech` stays `[]` at every tier. This profile's 'skipping the craft' gate can therefore only be satisfied in prose — every one of the four poem topics must carry one sentence of `explanation` naming its own પ્રાસ, લય, પુનરાવર્તન or ધ્વનિ in plain child words, quoting the કડી's printed syllables and never a device name.

The ટેક is identical at all five occurrences (`tek_words_changed: false`), so it is taught once in M1.S1.T1 and referenced afterwards through `depends_on`. No later topic may re-teach the refrain as new material, and no `original_chunk` may expand the printed shorthand `- હો ભેરુ.`; the expansion belongs in `explanation` only.

Slogan pressure is chapter-wide, not merely per-topic, because the printed apparatus supplies ready-made slogans: the exercise paraphrase `દોસ્ત, આપણે આપણા ભરોસે જ જીવવું જોઈએ` and the writing topic `'જાત મહેનત જિંદાબાદ'`. Both are printed exercise text and belong to `exercise_solutions.json` alone; neither may be quoted, echoed or reworded inside any topic's teaching fields as the poem's message.

The std-7 real-life-example failure mode meets this chapter's sea picture. `real_life_example` must not become a description of a દરિયાકિનારો, a boat, a fishing village or a place at all — a list has no ભાવ. One moment with a before and an after inside it, in the child's own experience (the hand that let go of the cycle and the cycle kept going), per profiles/students/std-7.md §2.
No numbers in display text, standing. `પહેલી કડીમાં`, `બીજી કડીમાં`, `ટેકની પંક્તિમાં`, `સ્વાધ્યાયનો પહેલો ભાગ` — never `કડી 1`, `પ્રશ્ન 4`. Numbers survive only in ids and provenance fields.
